rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 20 sites from 17 scanning locations in the ABIDE dataset; multiple scanner manufacturers (SIEMENS, Philips, GE) and platforms
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The ABIDE data set has been obtained by aggregating data from 20 independent samples collected at 17 different scanning locations (Di Martino et al., 2014)."
rci1_using_msad.location: Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / Site effects in the ABIDE data set, Section 3.1.2

rci2_using_epd.detail: ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) used as reference data for normative model training
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We used the healthy control sample from the ABIDE (autism brain imaging data exchange, http://preprocessed-connectomes-project.org/abide/) (Di Martino et al., 2014) data set"

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABIDE preprocessed connectomes project; healthy control sample used for normative model construction
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "We used the healthy control sample from the ABIDE (autism brain imaging data exchange, http://preprocessed-connectomes-project.org/abide/)"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC from ABIDE; 70% of healthy controls; split preserved distribution of age, sex and site. Supplementary reports 391 for the full training set before region-wise missing value exclusion.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we split the the healthy control data set into a training set (70% of data, n=389) and a test set (30% of data, n=166)"
rci5_n.location: Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / Splitting the ABIDE data set, Section 3.3

rci6_sex.detail: Training-specific sex breakdown not reported. Overall controls (N=569): 470 male (82.6%), 99 female (17.4%). Split preserved sex distribution, so training proportions are expected to be similar.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "we used 569 controls for development and performance testing of the models, out of which 470 were male" ... "the distribution of age, sex and site was preserved between sets"
rci6_sex.location: Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / Data, Section 3.1.1; Methods / Splitting, Section 3.3

rci7_age.detail: Training-specific age mean/SD not reported. Overall controls (N=569): male M=17.5 SD=8.3, female M=15.6 SD=7.0; weighted mean=17.17, pooled SD=8.09; range 6.5-40 years. Split preserved age distribution so training values expected to be similar. Age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "Controls : Age male subjects: M = 17.5., SD = 8.3. Age female subjects: M = 15.6, SD = 7.0., range = 6.5-40"
